english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a recreational hike, especially one on hills or trails.
This is the all-purpose casual term for walking in the countryside for pleasure or sport.

examples.english: We are going on a hike on Sunday.

examples.english: We’re going hiking in Lantau on Sunday.
examples.traditional: 我哋星期日去大嶼山行山。
